name: r8-h-dataflow-queue
author: solx-loop
description: H38 (lineage H, E3): one cooperative persistent tcgen05 kernel, 148 CTAs with 256 threads each, works through a static queue [W1 units][conv units][GEMM1 tiles][W2 units][GEMM2 tiles]. CTAs claim items from an atomic head one item ahead. Each item waits only on self-resetting per-image counters (w1_done, conv_done[b], g1_done[b], w2_done), so there is no grid barrier.
